_comment: Your standard application answers. Fill these once. The vault generator surfaces them per job so you paste instead of retype. Nothing here is auto-submitted — you copy into each form yourself. Review legal/attestation answers every single time.

workAuthorization._note: REVIEW THESE PER APPLICATION — attestations are legally binding.
workAuthorization.workAuthorizationStatement: Indian citizen. Authorized to work in India without sponsorship. Would require sponsorship for roles outside India.

logistics.willingToRelocate: Open to Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurgaon for the right role
logistics.remotePreference: Open to onsite (Pune), hybrid, or remote-India

compensation._note: Keep ranges, not single numbers. Re-check expectations per role/level.
compensation.salaryExpectationStatement: Open to discussing a package aligned with the role, level, and market.

experience.certifications: CSPO; AWS Solution Architect Associate; AWS Cloud Practitioner

screeningAnswers._note: Reusable long-text answers. Swap <COMPANY>/<ROLE> per application.
screeningAnswers.whyThisCompany: I'm drawn to <COMPANY> because of its scale and the depth of its platform work. My background building enterprise IAM, authorization, and cloud-platform products maps directly to the problems <COMPANY> is solving, and I want to contribute to products used by millions.
screeningAnswers.whyThisRole: The <ROLE> role sits exactly where my strengths are: owning platform/product strategy for identity, authorization, and cloud services at enterprise scale, and turning complex technical requirements into shipped outcomes.
screeningAnswers.greatestStrength: Translating ambiguous, highly technical platform requirements into clear roadmaps and shipped capabilities — e.g. taking identity-governance access reviews from 68% to 97% completion and cutting onboarding from a 2-day SLA to near real-time.
screeningAnswers.biggestAchievement: Owning the product lifecycle for IAM offerings impacting 35M+ users at JPMorgan Chase, increasing delivery velocity 30% while driving critical/high vulnerabilities to zero.
screeningAnswers.leadershipStyle: Outcome-focused and collaborative — I align engineering, security, and business stakeholders around clear priorities, then protect the team's focus so they can deliver.
screeningAnswers.shortBio: Senior Technical Product Manager with 11+ years delivering enterprise platform products across IAM, cloud platforms, authorization services, and API ecosystems for products serving millions of users.

demographics._note: EEO/voluntary disclosure questions. Answer only what you choose; many are optional. REVIEW PER APPLICATION.
